title: Pluralized toast titles via t() count + defaultValue_one/defaultValue_other
answers: How do I add a pluralized i18n string for a toast/label?
What's the pattern for singular vs plural translation keys in Grafana?
How to translate 'file added' vs 'files added'
body: For pluralized UI text, call `t(key, '', { count, defaultValue_one: '...', defaultValue_other: '...' })` and add the corresponding `<key>_one` / `<key>_other` entries to public/locales/en-US/grafana.json (not a single key). See Step1AlertmanagerResources.tsx's templates-added-title usage and the `templates-added-title_one`/`templates-added-title_other` entries.
applies: Any new user-facing string in this codebase that varies by count (singular/plural)
